{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "A slot the description says is not needed is not an item: give it worn false. One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note; then items is empty."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream silk blouse, relaxed fit, elbow-length sleeves, cream, silk.
Charcoal wide-leg trousers, tapered leg at ankle, full length, charcoal wool crepe.
Oversized unstructured blazer, boxy cut, hip-length, heather grey melange wool blend.
Leather loafers, almond toe, mid-calf, tan, smooth calfskin leather.
Thin silver chain necklace and minimalist gold hoop earrings.

This outfit works because the dark trousers and structured blazer provide a polished, professional silhouette suitable for a theatre setting while allowing you to walk comfortably during the concert. The cream silk blouse offers a soft contrast that aligns with your classic register without feeling too formal for an autumn evening at a club. Completing the look with tan leather loafers ensures you can move freely through the venue while maintaining an elegant, neat appearance."}
